name: Soukou no Shiro
source:
Main character comes to a castle where princess is taken away by demons. Together with his childhood friend they managed to rescue the princess, but another person got captured. No more half-hearted measures. What kingdom needs is the assault on demon territories.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/05/vn-of-month-november-2002-baldr-force.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角来到一座城堡，发现公主被恶魔掳走。他与青梅竹马成功救出公主，但另一个人却被抓走了。不能再半途而废。王国需要的是对恶魔领地发动进攻。

[来源：[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/05/vn-of-month-november-2002-baldr-force.html]vndbreview[/url]]
